map.task: Map Pi Engineering CLI production risks from repository evidence only. Focus on: (1) terminal width/overflow test failures, (2) graph/workflow packaging hygiene, (3) open-brain auth/provider paths, (4) anything that blocks a v1 local production release. Cite concrete file paths. Do not modify files.

adversarial.task: Adversarial review of the researcher's findings. Challenge weak claims, note missing verification, and rank the top 5 release blockers with severity. Cite files. Do not modify files.

plan.task: Using only prior observations, write a concise production remediation plan into docs/LIVE_PLATFORM_RUN_PLAN.md with: ordered fixes, test commands, and explicit non-goals (no UI redesign, no deletions). Keep it under 120 lines. Use registered checks if helpful. Prefer one new markdown file only.
